correctness.rationale: The arclength boundary objective is strictly convex, so its unique minimizer lies on the symmetry axis and solves the explicit scalar derivative B_h(q)=0. Independent high-precision quadrature agreed with the closed expression below 1e-42. At q=1/3 the independently recomputed signs are B_0.1≈−0.0197076574, B_0.125≈+0.0285128683, B_1≈+0.10509727, B_2≈−0.02981764; rigorous signs can be obtained from the supplied interval algorithm, while the existence follows by continuity and the separated signs. Equilateral h=√3 is forced by rotational symmetry, with nonzero negative parameter derivative. The source's uniform local expansions around the unique q→1/2 root support both h→0 and ∞ asymptotic corrections. No uniqueness of non-equilateral height is asserted.
